coexistence_model.meaning: An official Nanjing 59-ke locality standard and a printed Tongshu summer-solstice 60-ke branch coexisted in the early Ming. Historical transmission was layered rather than one-table replacement.
coexistence_model.model: older coarse seasonal/leak-clock 40↔60 family + Ming Nanjing locality/calendar numerical layer + unresolved selection/quantization/editorial recomposition -> Sanming 1578 displayed 59/41 summer-solstice cap
